title: Treasury yields highlight barriers to tokenized money market fund adoption
why_it_matters: Tokenized Treasury and money market products could connect blockchain liquidity with conventional short-term interest income, but investor eligibility, minimum subscriptions and redemption schedules limit whether they can replace readily transferable stablecoins.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

Treasury yields highlight barriers to tokenized money market fund adoption

A November 21 analysis compares stablecoin and Treasury yields, while separate November 17 reporting says recent stablecoin outflows have not flowed into tokenized funds.
